import json,re
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for n,b,a,c in [(3,'rough','acute','high'),(19,'unreadable','none','low'),(52,'smooth','grave','high'),(59,'smooth','circumflex','high'),(69,'smooth','acute','low')]:
 it=items[n-1];r=rows[n-1]
 r.update(breathing=next(k for k,v in it['breathing_options'].items() if v==b),accent=next(k for k,v in it['accent_options'].items() if v==a),confidence=c)
open('answers.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))
schema=json.load(open('answer_schema.json'))
assert len(rows)==len(items)==100
for it,r in zip(items,rows):
 assert list(r)==['item_id','breathing','accent','confidence','note']
 assert r['item_id']==it['item_id'] and re.fullmatch(schema['properties']['item_id']['pattern'],r['item_id'])
 assert r['breathing'] in it['breathing_options'] and r['accent'] in it['accent_options']
 assert r['confidence'] in ['high','low'] and isinstance(r['note'],str)
print('Validated 100 lines: count, order, schema, and per-item option validity.')
